_comment: 登录页移除测试账号登录，仅保留微信登录

zh: 扫码绑定设备，支持 Modbus、MQTT 等设备接入
实时查看设备属性与运行状态，远程下发开关与参数
场景一键执行，规则自动联动
OAuth 账号一键登录，多组织切换
应用内检查更新，新版本一键下载安装
界面支持 66 种语言，跟随系统语言，也可在「我 → 语言设置」里搜索切换；阿拉伯语等从右向左语言已适配
en: Scan a QR code to bind devices over Modbus, MQTT and more
Live device properties and states, with remote switches and parameters
One-click OAuth sign-in with organization switching
In-app update check with one-tap download and install
The UI now supports 66 languages, following your system language or searchable under Profile → Language; right-to-left scripts (Arabic and friends) are fully adapted
